notes.title: 2025.7.18 Update
notes.content:
The visual effect of object outlines has been enhanced

Some elemental mechanisms have been optimized, and the frequency of element calculation tick has slowed down.

Endless mode now records the highest score

Previously, the difficulty in endless mode increased with each wave of enemies, which gradually increased the damage taken by player, causing the player to be killed instantly by his own explosives. Now almost all explosive weapons have added some minor self-damage, which will not be increased by the difficulty. The difficulty increase will only increase damage from enemies. Now the difficulty will also slowly increase the health of enemies.

Added stricter air wall restrictions to prevent monsters from flying too far to unexpected locations.
Adjusted the volume of some overly noisy demon sounds and added some new random BGMs endless mode.

notes.title: 2025.6.25 Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831444/e99783f704def28dfe2888c2af591c348db966c6.png"]

A new heavy weapon has been added 

Pandemonium Cluster Grenade Launcher 

It can quickly spray a large number of explosive bullets to engulf enemies 

It cannot be picked up in the story mode at present, only in the endless siege mode. In the future, the story mode maps and effects will be reworked and a pickup method will be added. You can click a very small hidden button hidden in the upper left corner of the game's main menu to enter the developer's experimental map, which will contain upcoming things. 

Endless Siege Mode: 

Endless Siege Mode has been initially improved: 

the way to obtain weapons is now to unlock weapon boxes in the map, rather than drawing them in the card selection interface.

The card selection interface has also been significantly improved. 



Mediator: Damage mechanism changed: 

The angle of the barrier is now determined by the angle of the surface it hits Secondary mode is no longer a howitzer. The bullets in the secondary mode can still hit and demolish the barrier you create, but will only explode if they hit an enemy, and the enemy hit is in a radiation unstable state, which will instantly kill non-boss enemies. 

Its weapon customization plugin has been changed, and now the default shape of the barrier is a board, which is more suitable for temporary cover. 



A lot of code optimization: It has been quite a long time since the last update, and a lot of scattered issues have been fixed during this period. 



Fixed a critical memory leak: After the enemy dies and disappears, its projectiles still in memory. After fixing this problem, it should solve the problem of the game frame rate getting lower and lower during playtime.

notes.title: Enemy AI / Combat Update
notes.content:
This is a change that increases the difficulty.
Because in the past, players could often find a safe place to stay still without being threatened.
Or slow-moving monsters could not catch up with the players, enables player to win without a fight,this is  not good.

Although this situation is unavoidable, for some melee enemies, this design mistake destroys the game mechanics, so some additional attack methods must be given to melee enemies。There can't be completely harmless demonic entity.

notes.title: Origin system,mechanic fix
notes.content:
Changed some damage mechanics to make Origin bonuses better calculated
Fire damage now will do damage while under sustained attack, and it is faster(In Older Version,Your Attack will pause Dot damage)
The Pyromancer applies a "fire phobia" debuff to the enemy, which removes their resistance to  flame and causes the flame not to decay, but to burn brighter overtime
The effects of the Origin system are now as follows:

Tundra Pioneer
Run faster, + 2 Extra armor
Wastelander
Max HP +300, Heal speed +30% (Also mean -30% time delay for healing to start)
Jackal Slayer
Melee damage +40%, melee hit heal yourself (Every hit heals,Big Enemy heals you a lot )
Pyromancer
Your attacks will erase the enemy's fire resistance, Flame is Relentless
Iron Saint
All Guns Deal +30% Radiant Damage (130% overall Radiant Damage)
